'''Saass worms''' were rare creatures from the object [[G'haris]],<ref name="FJ" /> which was located in the [[G'haris system/Legends|eponymous star system]], part of the [[Perinn sector/Legends|Perinn sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; based on corresponding data for [[G'haris system/Legends|G'haris system]]</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] had a large table carved from dark red wood and covered by an exquisite cloth spun from the [[Silk/Legends|silk]] of the rare saass worms of G'haris.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The saass worms was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2011]].<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/68770/star-wars-fate-of-the-jedi-ascension-by-christie-golden|text=Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi: Ascension}}</ref>
